question: How many passenger journeys does one city bus make in its working life, in millions?
answer: A bus serves 12 to 15 years: ~1.7 million boardings.
move: One bus moves more people in its life than live in Milan.
hint: Journeys per day, times days per year, times years of service.
steps: A busy city bus carries roughly 400 boardings a day.
It runs around 320 days a year: ~128,000 a year.
A bus serves 12 to 15 years: ~1.7 million boardings.
reference: Department for Transport, Annual bus statistics: England, 2019
